features.name: Orders
features.description: Creating orders through the Orders API and seeing them on the Orders page.

userStories.title: Create an order
userStories.benefit: the products are delivered to me
acceptanceCriteria: [@functional] POST /api/v1/orders with a valid product id (SKU-1001) and a quantity of 2 returns 201 and the new order id.
[@error-handling] POST /api/v1/orders with a quantity of 0 returns 400 with the message 'Quantity must be at least 1'.
[@functional] The Orders page lists the new order after it is created.
businessRules: A quantity must be at least 1.
